method_transfer.source: Lake Crescent frozen replay rule transferred without outcome-dependent change
method_transfer.patch_geometry: candidate disk radius r plus annulus 1.25r < distance <= 2r
method_transfer.standardization: positive robust z from same-stratum control median and 1.4826*MAD
method_transfer.zero_mad_rule: exclude metric from standardized aggregate when same-stratum control MAD is exactly zero
method_transfer.aggregate_score: 0.5*max(active positive robust z)+0.5*mean(active positive robust z)

backscatter_ingest.valid_pixel_rule: native TIFF mask valid AND finite; honor explicit source nodata if present; no value-sign or distribution-based masking
backscatter_ingest.georeference_rule: use embedded non-identity 3 m transform; otherwise require one source world file and apply standard pixel-center to raster-corner conversion
backscatter_ingest.candidate_coordinate_system: must match source raster projected coordinate system; no candidate recentering

population_test.primary: stratified permutation of candidate mean aggregate score, preserving observed candidate count in every tile x radius stratum
promotion_requires_all: candidate mean aggregate score > pooled stratum-matched control mean aggregate score
population_test.secondary: one-sided Mann-Whitney candidate aggregate scores > pooled stratum-matched control aggregate scores
population_test.degenerate_stratum_rule: If any tile x radius stratum containing one or more scoreable frozen candidates has fewer than 2 active nonzero-MAD metrics, the preregistered primary validation is BLOCKED and scientific promotion is false; do not silently drop that stratum.
